Oxford United apologizes for 'United 93' shirt release near 9/11 anniversary

English soccer club Oxford United has apologized for releasing a clothing range named 'United 93' around the anniversary of the September 11th attacks. The club acknowledged the insensitivity of the timing and the name of the range. The apology was issued following criticism and the club stated they understood the concerns raised.
